title: ste-lint configuration
description: The configuration of ste-lint. All properties are optional.

include.description: Glob patterns of the files to examine, relative to this file.

ignore.description: Glob patterns of the files not to examine, relative to this file.

technicalNouns.description: Technical nouns of the project glossary. A term can have more than one word.

technicalVerbs.description: Technical verbs of the project glossary, in the base form.

properNouns.description: Names of products, organizations and standards. A name with more than one word counts as one word.

allowedWords.description: Other words that the -ing rule and the unknown-word rule accept.

wordList.description: Entries to add to the project word list, or to change in it.

id.description: The ID of a default entry to change.

match.description: The words or phrases to find.

suggest.description: The words to write instead, as the message shows them.

verbOnly.description: Find the words only where they are verbs.

dictionaryPath.description: The path of a local dictionary file. Never commit a dictionary. The environment variable STE_DICTIONARY has priority.
